category_title: Low-achieving EFL learners exhibiting hesitation, distraction, and lack of participation in mainstream classes
minimal_context: The student and tutor are working one-on-one in a remedial session to complete a textbook exercise on the Present Perfect and Simple Past tenses.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your textbook to the exercise about the Present Perfect and the Simple Past tense. Let's complete the first few sentences.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am ready and taking notes. I am not embarrassed to ask here, so can you tell me what this means before we start?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think the answer to the first question is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It says 'I have finished my homework.' (Speaks in Arabic). Is it just the same as the simple past tense?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the verbs again and try your best to figure it out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaks constantly in Arabic) We do not have this structure in Arabic! I am going to use Google Translate right now for instantaneous understanding because I need to negotiate the translation to make sense of this textbook. Why can't I just use the simple past?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open your textbook to the exercise about the Present Perfect and the Simple Past tense. Let's complete the first few sentences.

STUDENT: I am ready and taking notes. I am not embarrassed to ask here, so can you tell me what this means before we start?

TUTOR: What do you think the answer to the first question is?

STUDENT: It says 'I have finished my homework.' (Speaks in Arabic). Is it just the same as the simple past tense?

TUTOR: Look at the verbs again and try your best to figure it out.

STUDENT: (Speaks constantly in Arabic) We do not have this structure in Arabic! I am going to use Google Translate right now for instantaneous understanding because I need to negotiate the translation to make sense of this textbook. Why can't I just use the simple past?

task.content: Learning certain structures which do not occur in the Arabic language, such as the present perfect or idiomatic phrases

context.materials: Text book, instructional videos, timelines, and Google translate

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When encountering an overlap in the function conveyed by the Simple Past tense and the Present Perfect
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Constantly speak in Arabic, and negotiate the translation to employ it appropriately to the material at hand

behavior_patterns.condition: When pointing out areas of difficulty during tutor questioning
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Write down notes which they take away with them, give feedback, and confidently ask questions
behavior_patterns.internal_state: At ease, more focused and interested in learning; relaxed and not embarrassed to ask
